near_duplicates.method: union-find over shared human-text identity plus word-8-shingle Jaccard >= 0.8 (exact verification; crc32 index proposes candidates only). Cross-language near-dup pairs are covered by the same global index; the shared-human-text check additionally catches train/test overlap of the underlying human texts.
